cases.name: it says a field type cannot be changed after creation
cases.reply:
Relaticle doesn't support converting an existing custom attribute's type in place (there's no "change type" operation, per [Use custom attributes](http://relaticle.test/help/getting-started/use-custom-fields)): a field's type is fixed once created. The equivalent is to deactivate the current text "Region" field (keeping its values intact) and create a new select attribute with the same name and your choice of options.

Want me to deactivate "Region" and propose a new select attribute with the options you have in mind?
